note: Values transcribed from the cited manufacturer documents (MANUFACTURER_DOCUMENTED). PDFs are not redistributed; see ../../docs/SOURCES_R06.json for URLs and SHA-256.

T35_LVCMOS33.source: Efinix T35 DS v3.2 Table 66 (3.3 V LVCMOS)

MN820_MODULE.source: MN820 DS v1.0 Table 3 (module connector levels)

BT820_VCCIO1.note: exact VCCIO1 tolerance not transcribed; 3.0-3.6 V is the MN820 module input range (MN820 DS 5.1)

t35_bga400.source: Efinix T35 DS v3.2 Table 12; T35-PINOUT v1.5 (R05 system/T35F400_package_source_facts.csv)
t35_bga400.vccio_ddr_when_unused: Floating. Leave unconnected (T35 DS power-pin table, VCCIO_DDR row)
t35_bga400.gpio_during_config: weak pull-up (T35 DS 'General-Purpose I/O Logic and Buffer')
t35_bga400.creset_n_vil: CRESET_N is a Schmitt input with internal weak pull-up (Table 69 note); 3.3 V VIL max 0.8 V (Table 66) used as the threshold

f133.spi_modes: Standard, Dual-Output/Dual-Input, Dual IO, Quad-Output/Quad-Input (F133 DS 2.10.5). Quad-IO (quad address phase) NOT listed.
f133.boot_media: SD card, eMMC, SPI NOR, SPI NAND; GPIO pins and eFuse select boot media (F133 DS 2.2.1). BOOT-SEL[1:0] on PC4/PC5 Function4 (Table 4-3). Encoding NOT in the datasheet.
f133.power_sequence: VCC-IO before VDD-SYS/VDD-CORE by >= 2 ms; RESET low until rails stable > 64 ms (F133 DS 5.12.1)
f133.audio: HPOUTL/R (pins 99/98), HPOUTFB (100), HPVCC 1.8 V; DAC 16/20-bit, 8-192 kHz (F133 DS 2.8.1, Table 4-2)
f133.boot_select_table: D1-H User Manual v1.0 sec 3.3.2.1 Tables 3-4/3-5: BOOT_MODE(eFuse)=0 -> GPIO select; 00 SPI NOR->SPI NAND; 01 SMHC0->SPI NOR->other; 10 SMHC0->SPI NAND->other; 11 SMHC0->EMMC2_BOOT->EMMC2_USR->other. Status VER_REG 0x03000024[12:11].

bt820.host_if: QSPI slave, SPI mode 0 only, up to 60 MHz (Tsclk >= 16.6 ns), Single/Dual/Quad; default Single (BT820 DS 4.5, Table 28)
bt820.quad_address_phase: Quad mode transmits address and data on IO3..IO0, MSB on IO3 (BT820 DS 4.5.1)
bt820.read_protocol: addr MSB=0, 4 address bytes, poll for 0x01 data-valid byte, then data (BT820 DS 4.5.1)
bt820.write_protocol: addr MSB=1, 4 address bytes, data; 32-bit word units, word-aligned (BT820 DS 4.5.1)
bt820.host_command: 0xFF, cmd, param, 0x00, 0x00; ACTIVE = five 0x00 bytes; Single mode only (BT820 DS 4.5.2.3)
bt820.data_pulldowns_required: bi-directional data ports must have pull-downs (BT820 DS 4.5.1)
bt820.rst_n: connect to MCU GPIO, or 47k pull-up + 1 uF (BT820 DS 3.2)

mn820_cn1.power: single 3.0-3.6 V input (MN820 DS 5.1, Table 3 Icc 245 mA typ). Table 2/3 'output' wording is baseboard-side: VM820C DS v1.1 Fig. 5/7 show the baseboard buck output VCC3V3 on CN6 pins 13/15/17/19.
